verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a self-hosted runtime: it runs as a local binary or Docker container serving on localhost, and its shell agent works on your own machine. Data residency is therefore decided by where the user deploys it, with distributed worker nodes also under the operator's control. The docs never explicitly describe where data is persisted or guarantee that nothing leaves the host, and remote gRPC backends and external MCP servers can send traffic off-box. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of data storage locations/persistence and a no-telemetry/no-egress guarantee, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of data locality.
